news.title: SK Hynix Drops Near 11% as KOSPI Hits 37th Sidecar of 2026
news.summary: SK Hynix shares dropped 10.95% in Seoul as the KOSPI triggered its 37th sidecar of 2026 during a chip stock selloff.

news.title: LG Innotek secures automotive Wi-Fi 7 supply agreement
news.summary: The module will be installed in audio, video and navigation (AVN) systems that will in turn be supplied to an unnamed global original equipment manufacturer (OEM).

news.title: Applied Intuition and LG Innotek strike autonomous vehicle development partnership
news.summary: The arrangement is intended to fine-tune Applied Intuition’s Self Driving System (SDS) so it operates effectively with LG Innotek’s camera, lidar and radar sensors.
